feature: Per-wallet user-defined risk allocation with an explicitly selected historical Sharpe alternative

solver.name: grid-v1
solver.tieBreak: score tolerance, minimum target turnover, sorted asset weights
solver.inputs: explicit user assumptions; optional labelled aligned return panel

limitations: Optimization is best within the specified grid plus feasible incumbent and user model, not a future-performance guarantee.
Historical inputs are supplied explicitly; no verified market-history feed exists in the app.
Historical diagnostics use constant weights per observation and omit execution costs.
User risk scores are subjective points, not calibrated loss probabilities.
